newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia and Israel sign film production treaty.
newsitem.headline: Australia and Israel sign film production treaty.

text.p: Australia and Israel signed a film co-production agreement treaty to improve co-operation on film projects between the two countries, the Australian Film Commission (AFC) said on Wednesday.

The co-production treaty was designed to assist the industries and filmmakers to improve the quality and competitiveness of their productions by allowing for a pooling and exchange of creative and financial resources, AFC said.
The commission said productions approved under these arrangements are eligible for government funding.

Australia already has film co-production agreements with Canada, Britain and Italy and is close to finalising agreements with Germany and Ireland. It also has less than treaty status arrangements with France and New Zealand.
AFC said films made under the co-productions include Sirens (Australia/Britain), Black Robe (Australia/Canada) and Map of the Human Heart (Australia/France/Britain/Canada).
